summary: Tested the new 'Ver Atendimento' feature in /agenda end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 6 backend tests pass and the full UI flow works: completed appointment shows only the 'Ver Atendimento' button (no WhatsApp/Confirmar/Iniciar/Cancelar), dialog opens with all required sections (header, 4 summary cards, Atendimento clinical fields, products table, pagamento), receipt PDF download is triggered, close/reopen works, and 'Novo Atendimento' navigates to /atendimento/{patient_id}. One minor cosmetic issue: total formatted as 'R$ 1500,00' instead of 'R$ 1.500,00' (no thousands separator).

issues: Total card shows 'R$ 1500,00' instead of 'R$ 1.500,00'. Agenda.js line ~1031 uses parseFloat(payment_amount).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') which omits the thousands separator. Recommend using new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }).format(value) for consistent BRL formatting (this is how other screens like the receipt PDF and finance pages format it).

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Replace `R$ ${(parseFloat(recordData.payment_amount || 0)).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}` in Agenda.js line ~1031 with Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'}).format(recordData.payment_amount || 0) so values like 1500 render as 'R$ 1.500,00'.

Pre-existing bug from iteration_1 (NOT related to this feature): POST /api/medical-records does not deduct product stock because the lookup uses {'id': product_id} but products are stored with qr_code_id. Still need to fix server.py create_medical_record filters from 'id' to 'qr_code_id'. This was flagged previously and is unrelated to Ver Atendimento.
critical_code_review_comments: Agenda.js is now ~1205 lines — consider extracting the RecordViewDialog into its own component file (RecordViewDialog.jsx) along with openRecordView/downloadRecordReceipt helpers for maintainability.

openRecordView fallback logic uses `list.find(r => r.date === apt.date)` — if the same patient has multiple records on the same date this picks the first one regardless of which appointment created it. Safer to filter by `r.appointment_id === apt.id` first and fall back to date matching only if no appointment_id match is found.

Currency formatting is inconsistent across the app: receipt PDF and finance use Intl.NumberFormat (pt-BR / BRL) while this new dialog uses manual toFixed+replace. Standardize through a single helper (utils/format.js).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all critical flow checks (button visibility, dialog open, content render, all fields, PDF download triggered, close+reopen, navigation to new atendimento)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (completed appointment a57561a8 at 15:00 + record 9f5e631b). No new data created, no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ver Atendimento feature is fully working. test_view_record.py covers backend coverage permanently. UI verified via Playwright: dialog content matches all expected fields, download triggers a blob file 'recibo_Maria_Silva_2026-06-23.pdf', navigation to /atendimento/{patient_id} works. Only cosmetic improvement remaining is the currency thousands-separator (line ~1031 of Agenda.js). The pre-existing stock-deduction bug from iteration_1 has NOT been verified as fixed in this iteration — flag for retest if main agent claims fix.
rca of the issue: No new bugs introduced by this feature. The 'R$ 1500,00' display is not a bug per se but inconsistent with the rest of the app — use Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'}) for consistency.
